mapper.select: SELECT t_safetyInfo.id, t_safetyInfo.t_shijian, t_safetyInfo.t_overall, t_safetyInfo.t_incident, t_safetyInfo.t_bz, t_safetyInfo.addTime, t_oilFieldInfo.id oilFieldInfo_id FROM t_safetyInfo, t_oilFieldInfo WHERE t_safetyInfo.id = #{id} AND t_safetyInfo.oilFieldInfo_id = t_oilFieldInfo.id

SELECT t_safetyInfo.id, t_safetyInfo.t_shijian, t_safetyInfo.t_overall, t_safetyInfo.t_incident, t_safetyInfo.t_bz, t_safetyInfo.addTime, t_oilFieldInfo.id oilFieldInfo_id FROM t_safetyInfo, t_oilFieldInfo WHERE 1 = 1 AND t_safetyInfo.oilFieldInfo_id = t_oilFieldInfo.id
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_location like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_status like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_production like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_bz like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_safetyInfo.t_shijian like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_safetyInfo.t_overall like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_safetyInfo.t_incident like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_safetyInfo.t_bz like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_safetyInfo.addTime like '%${fieldValue}%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_safetyInfo(addTime,t_shijian, t_overall, t_incident, t_bz, oilFieldInfo_id ) VALUES(#{addTime},#{shijian}, #{overall}, #{incident}, #{bz}, #{oilFieldInfo.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_safetyInfo set t_shijian=#{shijian}, t_overall=#{overall}, t_incident=#{incident}, t_bz=#{bz}, oilFieldInfo_id =#{oilFieldInfo.id} where id=#{id}
